description: 충청북도_지역하천 측정정보 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도. 충청북도 지역하천 측정정보는 번호, 시군 지역, 채수 지점번호, 하천명, 위도·경도(GPS) 등 하천의 측정지점을 식별할 수 있는 공간 기반 정보를 제공하는 Open API로, 지역별. Coverage: 충청북도. The portal files it under the publisher 충청북도. Its tags are 수질, 상하수도, 물환경, 수질측정지점, 물환경모니터링. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
